ValidationRule.description: If the case status is "Withdrawn", it should not allow updates to previous statuses.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c == false, RecordType.DeveloperName = "Account_Closure", ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Withdrawn"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Open"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "On Hold"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Escalated") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the Case status from Withdrawn to Open, On Hold, or Escalated.
